_comment: Canonical EnrollmentToken wire shape. The gateway generates a one-time token after successful CLI enrollment. The token authenticates the browser-based passkey registration flow without exposing raw user_id and cli_session_id in the URL. Serialized from EnrollmentToken (internal/models/auth.go).

enrollment_token._description: One-time use token for secure passkey enrollment.

consumed.description: Whether the token has been used

consumed_at.description: When the token was consumed. Omitted when not consumed.
